summary: Produced the IDN-04 backend design artefact for API token management, covering token lifecycle (issue/store/list/revoke/validate), hash-only persistence, token identifier and secret format, expiration and revocation guarantees, API contracts, middleware integration with API-08 and IDN-03, security constraints, and full acceptance-criterion traceability. This was a design-only step with no implementation code changes.

tests_run.name: fn:validate-completeness (design acceptance coverage review)
tests_run.detail: All IDN-04 acceptance criteria and edge-case requirements map to explicit sections in the design artefact.

next_steps: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) to implement token issuance, listing, revocation, and auth validation wiring.
Route to TEST-DESIGNER (Step 3) to define IDN-04 API and auth boundary test cases.
Align auth middleware role-claim shape with additive-role semantics from IDN-03/IDN-04 before release validation.
